_about: Every public source a city map is made from, once. A city names a source in its city.json only to differ: its elevation project and coastal model, and the split settings of its footprints. Counties are found from the cut.

osm.source: OpenStreetMap contributors, through the Overpass API

footprints.licence: CC BY 4.0, as the Esri-hosted delivery item declares; a U.S. government work per catalog.data.gov. Attribution: Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL); Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Geospatial Response Office.
